notes.title: 《古代风流传》The subsequent storyline reveals
notes.notes: [p]Thank you all for your long-term support of《古代风流传》. Recently, we have seen many players asking about when the subsequent plot of the game will be released and other questions. Here, we would like to give a unified response and recommendation. [/p][p]《古代风流传》is already a complete game. The subsequent storyline where the protagonist leads troops into battle is presented in the second part, 《公主：东方与远征》, while the storyline of the protagonist's rebellion is featured in the third part, 《双雄风流传》. [/p][p]The above three installments constitute the complete story arc. Players who are interested can also directly purchase our combo package to enjoy the series at a lower price. [/p][p]Finally, I still hope everyone will support us more. It's not easy for a small production team to make a living. Thank you! Wish everyone a happy day every day![/p]

notes.title: Feedback Announcement on Public Welfare Activities
notes.notes: Dear players, in accordance with the tradition left behind, for every game purchased by a player, we will contribute our humble efforts to public welfare. This matter has never been replied to by everyone. From now on, we will send our donation records to all players from time to time. This is the result of everyone's joint efforts, and at the same time, this honor also belongs to everyone. Thank you all very much for your long-term support for our game and for public welfare!! Thank you!!

notes.title: Notice of the Domestic Game Challenge Reward Activity
notes.notes:
Dear players, the welfare storm is coming with great force! A mysterious big shot, with a passionate heart for domestic games, has launched this grand challenge event. There are numerous exciting gifts waiting for you to win! ​
Activity Rules
Game Achievement Challenge: Choose any one of the four ingenious domestic games, "Ancient Elegance", "Princess Gou Ba Rhapsodom", "Princess Dongfang and Expedition", and "Double Heroes' Legacy", to unlock all your achievements and write your game legend with your strength! ​
2. Game duration test: Accumulate 3 hours or more of playtime in the selected games, deeply immerse yourself in the elaborately crafted game world, and feel the charm of every detail. ​
3. Share game insights: After completing your achievements, go to the Steam game page and leave your genuine comments. Whether it's praise or suggestions, they can all inject new vitality into the game. ​

This reward is not only an acknowledgement of everyone's gaming skills, but also aims to promote the subsequent improvement and optimization of the game. Looking back over the past two years, from hand-drawing to the iterative upgrade of AI technology, every step of growth has been inseparable from the support of players. We are not a big company. We have made it this far all thanks to the company and encouragement of all our players. Every reward is our gratitude and repayment to all of you. Every reward carries our expectations for the future of the game. We hope that through everyone's participation and feedback, it will help us refine the game even more perfectly and achieve a transformation from zero to one and from something to something excellent. ​

Reward collection method
When you successfully complete the above three challenges, contact the administrator immediately, show the game achievement mark, duration record and screenshot of the Steam review, and you can participate in the event! ​
Don't hesitate any longer. Start this domestic game challenge journey right away. Fight for your passion and contribute to the development of domestic games. Who knows, the lucky prize might just win at your home!
